{
  "summary": "Added meeting-participation skill for AI deliberation with new skill matching/suggestion system and heartbeat-based discussion task creation. Critical issue: new database columns not added to skills table.",
  "learnings": [
    {"topic": "Database migrations", "reminder": "Always create a migration to add new columns BEFORE inserting data that uses them - the 034 migration inserts trigger_phrases/anti_patterns/quick_start/examples/emoji but no migration adds these columns to the skills table"},
    {"topic": "Type safety", "reminder": "In checkMeetingInvites, cast invite.metadata to Record<string, unknown> before accessing properties - metadata could be null causing runtime error"},
    {"topic": "Code duplication", "reminder": "getSuggestedSkills exists in both DatabaseSkillLoader.ts and SkillSystem.ts with different implementations - should be unified or one removed"},
    {"topic": "Null handling", "reminder": "In DatabaseSkillLoader.getAllSkills, the new fields (trigger_phrases, anti_patterns, examples) have fallback defaults but weren't in original schema - needs migration first"},
    {"topic": "SQL injection", "reminder": "Good: SQL INSERT uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING - prevents duplicate skill errors"}
  ],
  "findings": [
    {"severity": "critical", "type": "Missing migration", "location": "034_meeting_participation_skill.sql", "description": "Insert references columns (trigger_phrases, anti_patterns, quick_start, examples, emoji) that don't exist in skills table - insert will fail"},
    {"severity": "medium", "type": "Potential runtime error", "location": "HeartbeatService.ts:382", "description": "If invite.metadata is null/undefined, casting to Record<string, unknown> and accessing taskId could throw"},
    {"severity": "low", "type": "Code duplication", "location": "SkillSystem.ts vs DatabaseSkillLoader.ts", "description": "getSuggestedSkills duplicate implementation with different logic - should be consolidated"},
    {"severity": "low", "type": "No test coverage", "location": "All new code", "description": "No tests added for suggestSkills, checkSkillSuitability, findSkillsByTrigger, checkMeetingInvites"}
  ],
  "issues": [
    "Missing database columns: trigger_phrases, anti_patterns, quick_start, examples, emoji need to be added via ALTER TABLE migration",
    "Potential null reference in HeartbeatService checkMeetingInvites when metadata is null",
    "Code duplication between SkillSystem.suggestSkills and DatabaseSkillLoader.getSuggestedSkills"
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Create migration 035 to add missing columns: ALTER TABLE skills ADD COLUMN trigger_phrases TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN anti_patterns TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN quick_start TEXT, ADD COLUMN examples TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN emoji TEXT",
    "Add null check in HeartbeatService: const taskId = invite.metadata?.taskId",
    "Consolidate getSuggestedSkills to single implementation or remove duplicate"
  ],
  "praise": [
    "Anti-pattern detection is excellent feature for skill suitability checking",
    "Proper logging in HeartbeatService with [Meeting] prefix for debugging",
    "Good separation of concerns - SkillMatch interface properly encapsulates match details",
    "SQL uses parameterized queries preventing injection"
  ],
  "overallScore": 45,
  "codeQualityScore": 60,
  "testCoverageScore": 0,
  "documentationScore": 85
}
